criteria.clientCredentialsRefused: the public client refuses a client-credentials grant
criteria.controlPlaneRejectsBadToken: GET /v1/session with a malformed bearer answers 401
criteria.idpDiscoveryIssuer: the discovery issuer equals the string the control plane is given
criteria.idpHttpsVerified: TLS verifies against the internal CA bundle with hostname checking on
criteria.idpJwksSameOrigin: jwks_uri shares the issuer's origin and serves an RS256 signing key
criteria.idpNameResolves: the system resolver finds the IdP name; no substitute is accepted
criteria.passwordGrantRefused: the public client refuses a password grant (synthetic account only)
